name: frontend-5xx-errors
title: Frontend is repeatedly returning HTTP 5xx responses
description: The public frontend has returned at least one HTTP 5xx response during each of the last five minutes. This means frontend requests are repeatedly failing and require investigation.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs to identify the failing request paths, status codes, and errors
Check for recent deployments or infrastructure changes, then raise a bug or incident if further investigation is required, or try to resolve the issue if the cause is known.

query: fields @timestamp, status, request_method, request_uri, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, aws_request_id, @message, @logStream
